obs.setup.youtube_ok: OBS sends to the YouTube channel linked to Hallstream.
obs.setup.youtube_pus: I set OBS to send to the YouTube channel linked to Hallstream.
painel.ajuda.dia.1: Close the SL Live Stream app on phones and tablets. The box only accepts one connection.
painel.ajuda.dia.10: At the break or the end, Next game shows the following game. If it's greyed out, the button says why. The FPB only lists games for the next 14 days.
painel.ajuda.dia.11: Save score image makes the image for Instagram.
painel.ajuda.dia.12: In Screens, press End stream. With YouTube connected, the video becomes unlisted after a minute or two, and the link appears with Copy and Share on WhatsApp.
painel.ajuda.dia.13: To close Hallstream, open its icon's menu (by the clock on Windows, in the menu bar on a Mac) and choose Quit.
painel.ajuda.dia.2: Turn on the scoreboard console and the PC, and open DroidCam on the tablet. Open Hallstream from the shortcut if it didn't open with Windows. OBS opens by itself.
painel.ajuda.dia.3: At the top of Screens, wait for Box Connected and OBS Ready, in green. If Repair appears, press it.
painel.ajuda.dia.4: In Game, choose the age group and the FPB game, and mark who plays today.
painel.ajuda.dia.5: When Screens says Ready to stream, press Start stream. If something is missing, the list below says what. With YouTube connected, Hallstream creates the live stream with the title and thumbnail. Without it, press YouTube thumbnail instead and put the image on YouTube Studio. To try it without an audience, Test stream makes a private live stream, which only the channel's account sees in YouTube Studio.
painel.ajuda.dia.6: Opening, then Squad, and Scoreboard when the ball goes up.
painel.ajuda.dia.7: Leave Automatic on. The break and the end appear by themselves.
painel.ajuda.dia.8: In a timeout, press Timeout and, when play restarts, Scoreboard.
painel.ajuda.dia.9: In a technical pause, press Back soon and, when everything is back, Scoreboard.
painel.ajuda.dia.periodos: The points per quarter of the last game are only cleared by another game, age group or date. For a second manual game on the same day, press New game, at the end of the Game tab.
painel.ajuda.ficheiros.bluetooth: bluetooth.log the Bluetooth devices the program saw
painel.ajuda.ficheiros.dica: To open the folder, paste the path into the File Explorer address bar. For a backup, press Save backup in Settings.
painel.ajuda.ficheiros.marcador: marcador.log what the program has been doing
painel.ajuda.ficheiros.pasta: In the dados folder, next to the program.
painel.ajuda.ficheiros.promo: promo the videos from the Promo tab
painel.ajuda.inicio.dica: First, install OBS 31 or newer, and DroidCam on the PC and the tablet. New camera later? Choose it in Settings > Camera and press Set up OBS.
painel.ajuda.inicio.texto: Open the First-time setup, on the club's computer. There are five steps: club and box, OBS, YouTube, YouTube channel and a rehearsal.
painel.ajuda.lead: The READ-ME.txt, in the program folder, explains everything in more detail.
painel.ajuda.pc.1: On the old computer, in Settings > Backup, press Save backup and take the .zip file on a USB stick.
painel.ajuda.pc.2: On the new computer, install OBS 31 or newer and DroidCam. Unzip Hallstream to C:\Hallstream.
painel.ajuda.pc.3: With Hallstream closed, unzip the backup: right-click the .zip, Extract all, and type C:\Hallstream as the destination. Check that you end up with C:\Hallstream\dados, with everything you had, the YouTube connection included.
painel.ajuda.pc.4: Open Hallstream. In Settings, press Set up OBS and Create desktop shortcut. If Open with Windows was on, it stays on.
painel.ajuda.pc.5: Turn on the scoreboard console and wait for Box Connected. If it doesn't connect, see The box won't connect, further down.
painel.ajuda.pc.dica: If the old computer broke, use the last backup you saved. With no backup, do the First-time setup again: the players and photos come back from the FPB, but the sponsors' logos and the videos have to be uploaded again.
painel.ajuda.problemas.caixa_texto: Close the SL Live Stream app on the phone and the tablet. Then press Try on the device marked Likely.
painel.ajuda.problemas.camara: The camera is crooked or the wrong size
painel.ajuda.problemas.numero: A number on the scoreboard is wrong
painel.ajuda.problemas.numero_texto: Send the file dados\raw.log, with everything the box sent.
painel.ajuda.problemas.obs: The graphics don't show in OBS
painel.ajuda.problemas.obs_texto: Press Repair, at the top of Screens, or Set up OBS, in Settings. It fixes the source's address and port, and puts it above the camera.
painel.ajuda.problemas.outro_texto: Send the file dados\marcador.log, where the program writes what it has been doing.
painel.ajuda.problemas.som: The promo video has no sound
painel.ajuda.problemas.som_texto: Press Set up OBS, which turns on the sound of the graphics source. Also check that the video has Sound on.
painel.ajuda.problemas.telemovel: The panel won't open on the phone
painel.ajuda.problemas.telemovel_texto: Use the address in Settings > Phone, with the PC's IP. The phone has to be on the same Wi-Fi network.
painel.ajuda.yt.1: On another computer, with any Google account, create the OAuth client in Google Cloud. The guide is in YouTube\CONNECT-YOUTUBE.txt, in the program folder. Bring the ID and the secret to the club's PC.
painel.ajuda.yt.2: On the club's PC, open the First-time setup, YouTube step. Paste both and click Connect to YouTube.
painel.ajuda.yt.3: Sign in with the account that manages the club's channel and choose the club's channel. At the unverified app warning, click Advanced and then Go to Hallstream.
painel.ajuda.yt.dica: Live streams are in Streams. A custom thumbnail only works with a verified channel (youtube.com/verify). Without it, the live stream still starts.
painel.aparencia.destaque_dica: Lights up the bonus, the points just scored and the last seconds of the 24.
painel.aparencia.dica: Whatever you change here shows up in the preview straight away. It goes on air when you click Save.
painel.aparencia.estilo.classico_dica: The diagonal band in the club's colours.
painel.aparencia.estilo.cor_dica: Everything in shades of the club colour, with cut corners.
painel.aparencia.estilo.lombada_dica: Paper and ink, with the club colour on a spine.
painel.aparencia.estilo.pavilhao_dica: The wood, the court lines and the scorer's table tape.
painel.aparencia.estilo.placa_dica: White enamel plates, edged in the club colour.
painel.aparencia.foto_dica: Sits behind the big screens: opening, break, final score. A wide photo of the empty hall works best.
painel.aparencia.margem_dica: Increase it if the television cuts off the edges of the picture.
painel.aparencia.mostrar.faixa: The sponsors strip on the big screens
painel.aparencia.rodape_dica: If the scoreboard is at the bottom in the same spot, the footer moves to the other side.
painel.api.sem_ligacao: No connection to the program. Check that Hallstream is open.
painel.atalho.dica: To open Hallstream without going to the program folder.
painel.atualizacao.a_reiniciar: The panel comes back by itself.
painel.atualizacao.abrir_outra_vez: This is taking a while. If Hallstream doesn't come back, open it again.
painel.atualizacao.avisar: Tell me when a new version is out
painel.atualizacao.avisar_dica: Once a day, Hallstream asks GitHub for the latest version. It sends nothing about the club, and it only downloads when you click Update now.
painel.atualizacao.dica: Download the new version from the page and put it in place of this one. Your data stays.
painel.atualizacao.dica_instalar: I install the new version and restart. OBS stays open and your data doesn't change.
painel.atualizacao.falhou: {erro} You still have the version you had.
painel.atualizacao.no_pc: Update on the computer where Hallstream is running.
painel.atualizacao.perguntar: Should I tell you when a new version is out?
painel.atualizacao.perguntar_dica: I ask GitHub once a day and send nothing about the club. You can change this in Settings.
painel.caixa.abri_definicoes: I opened the settings on the computer.
painel.caixa.demo: Demo: the box isn't being used
painel.caixa.dispositivos_dica: If the box doesn't connect by itself, click Try on the device with the strongest signal. The list refreshes every 2 seconds.
painel.caixa.e_a_caixa: That's the box. Connected and saved.
painel.caixa.esquecer_dica: Searches for any box again, instead of this one.
painel.caixa.esquecer_texto: The program stops looking for only this box and connects to the first one it finds.
painel.caixa.feche_app: Close the SL Live Stream app on the tablet. The box only accepts one connection.
painel.caixa.lead: Bluetooth connection to the scoreboard's Stream Box.
painel.caixa.nenhum_ouvido: I haven't heard any device yet.
painel.calendario.link_dica: TeamSnap, SportsEngine, many federations and the club's own calendar give each team an .ics link. Its games join these, and the program reads it again once a day.
painel.calendario.vazio: No games scheduled yet. Add them here one by one, or import them from a CSV.
painel.calendario.vazio_fpb: The FPB games are under «Choose from FPB». Here you can add others, such as tournaments and friendlies.
painel.camaras.desconto_guarde: This shows the saved list. Save the new list first, then choose the timeout camera here.
painel.camaras.dica: Up to four cameras, each with its own scene in OBS and the graphics on top. Change the list, then click Save and set up OBS. Taking a camera off the list doesn't delete it from OBS.
painel.camaras.falta_escolha: Choose where camera {n}'s picture comes from.
painel.camaras.guarde_qr: Save to see the QR code.
painel.camaras.guia: Two to four cameras, on Wi-Fi or on cable: read the CAMERAS.txt guide in the program folder, or open it online.
painel.camaras.inset_dica: A small camera in the corner, on the scoreboard and the Nada screen.
painel.camaras.inset_no_ar: Camera {n} is on air, so it can't be the inset.
painel.camaras.internet: Needs the internet: the phone and OBS find each other through VDO.Ninja. The rest of Hallstream works offline.
painel.camaras.link_dica: If this panel is open on the phone that will film, copy the link and open it in the browser.
painel.camaras.mostrar_marcador_dica: When off, this camera goes on air without the corner scoreboard, the sponsor corner and the lower third. Full screens and the time-out show on every camera.
painel.camaras.nada_guarde: This shows the saved list. Save the new list first, then choose the Nothing screen's camera here.
painel.camaras.nao_guardada: I didn't save the list: OBS didn't answer. Sort out what is missing and press Save and set up OBS again.
painel.camaras.outra_cena: OBS is showing a scene that isn't any camera's.
painel.camaras.parada_dica: The picture hasn't changed in 20 seconds. On a phone, check whether the screen turned off or the app closed.
painel.camaras.qr_alt: QR code to connect camera {n}'s phone
painel.camaras.qr_dica: On the phone that will film, scan this code with its camera and open the link in the browser. Turn the phone sideways and keep it on the charger.
painel.camaras.saltou: OBS skipped {n} of {total} frames in the last minute: the PC can't keep up.
painel.camaras.sem_imagem_dica: Check the camera is on and, on a phone, that the VDO.Ninja page or DroidCam is open.
painel.canto.dica: One sponsor at a time, 10 seconds, in the top right corner, in the order of the strip. It doesn't show during timeouts or on full screens.
painel.canto.ligar: Sponsor in the corner during the game
painel.captura.abri_pasta: I opened the folder on the computer.
painel.captura.demo: The demo does not use the box, so there is nothing to record.
painel.captura.dica: Saves to dados/captura on this computer everything the box sends: scoreboard frames only (score, clock, fouls and team names). The team names are the ones typed into the console, often the club's name: check the file before you send it in public. Record a whole game and send it to the project, so the console can be tested with a real game. To send it, open "A problem or an idea" in Help and attach the file.
painel.captura.parou_caixa: The box disconnected and I stopped recording. Connect the box and switch it on again.
painel.captura.parou_erro: I could not keep recording. The reason is in dados/marcador.log.
painel.captura.parou_limite: The recording reached its size limit and stopped.
painel.captura.sem_caixa: Connect the box first: only what it sends can be recorded.
painel.clube.a_procurar: Searching for the club's teams on the FPB…
painel.clube.confira: Check the age groups here in the Squad and add what's missing, such as the coaches.
painel.clube.cores_dica: The main colour paints the scoreboard and the full screens, and the secondary one the dark strips. I put the text on top in white or dark, whichever reads better.
painel.clube.ecras_auto: Automatic screens when the program opens
painel.clube.nada_novo: There were no new age groups to create, and {jogadores} imported.
painel.csv.dica_jogos: One row per game: date, time, opponent, home or away and, if you want, the venue, the competition and the round.
painel.csv.dica_plantel: One row per player: number, name and, if you want, the address of a photo. You can do it in Excel and save as CSV. Players with the same name get the new number; nobody is deleted.
painel.definicoes.abre_mac: Opens when you sign in to the Mac
painel.definicoes.abrir_linux_dica: Hallstream opens by itself when you sign in. With "Open OBS with Hallstream", OBS opens too.
painel.definicoes.abrir_mac: Open when I sign in to the Mac
painel.definicoes.abrir_mac_dica: Hallstream opens by itself when you sign in to the Mac. With "Open OBS with Hallstream", OBS opens too.
painel.definicoes.abrir_obs_dica: OBS opens by itself and connects once Set up OBS has run well.
painel.definicoes.abrir_windows_dica: Hallstream opens by itself when you turn on the PC. With "Open OBS with Hallstream", OBS opens too.
painel.definicoes.atalho_criado: The shortcut has already been created. If you deleted it, you can create it again.
painel.definicoes.copia_dica: Saves the age groups, players, photos, sponsors, videos, settings and the YouTube connection in a .zip file. Save a copy after you change anything, on a USB stick or in a folder just for the club. Don't send it by email or WhatsApp: with it, anyone can stream on the club's channel.
painel.definicoes.credito: Show "made with Hallstream" on the stream
painel.definicoes.credito_dica: I put the small Hallstream logo in the bottom right corner, when it's free. It helps other clubs find out about the program.
painel.definicoes.dados_em: The data is kept in {pasta}. The file marcador.log holds the program's messages.
painel.definicoes.demo_dica: Shows a fake game on the stream, to test without the scoreboard's box. Turn it off before the game.
painel.definicoes.desconto_dica: During a timeout, OBS switches to this camera and its picture shrinks into the graphics window. At the end it goes back to the camera that was on air.
painel.definicoes.enquadramento_dica: With "Full image", a tablet held upright or in 4:3 gets margins. During a timeout, the margins turn blue.
painel.definicoes.fechar_dica: To close Hallstream, open its icon's menu (by the clock on Windows, in the menu bar on a Mac) and choose Quit.
painel.definicoes.fechar_obs_dica: When you choose Quit on the Hallstream icon, OBS closes too.
painel.definicoes.grafismo_mao: To add the graphics by hand: in OBS, Sources → + → Browser, paste this address, width 1920, height 1080, turn on "Control audio via OBS" and put the source above the camera.
painel.definicoes.idioma_dica: The panel, the on-air screens and the log all switch to this language.
painel.definicoes.lead: Normally you only touch this once.
painel.definicoes.modo_antigo: Old mode, with a separate scene for the timeout
painel.definicoes.modo_antigo_dica: Only if you already have a timeout scene in OBS. Leave it blank for the camera to shrink by itself.
painel.definicoes.nada_dica: On the Nothing screen, OBS switches to this camera. When you move to a screen without its own camera, it goes back to the camera that was on air.
painel.definicoes.nao_abre_linux: No longer opens when you sign in
painel.definicoes.nao_abre_mac: No longer opens when you sign in to the Mac
painel.definicoes.obs_dica: Click Set up OBS once, with the tablet connected. Hallstream sets OBS up by itself: it turns on the WebSocket server, creates the Graphics scene with the graphics and one scene per camera with the graphics on top, and sets the resolution to 1920x1080. You can click it again whenever you like. Whatever is already right stays as it is.
painel.definicoes.obs_mao: OBS connection set up by hand
painel.definicoes.obs_mao_dica: Only if OBS is on another computer, or if Set up OBS can't turn on the server. In OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings.
painel.definicoes.pin_telemovel: To allow the phone, enter a 4-digit PIN.
painel.definicoes.setup_dica: Seven steps: language, club, scoring, OBS, YouTube and a rehearsal.
painel.definicoes.telemovel_depois: The change only takes effect when you reopen the program.
painel.definicoes.telemovel_dica: Opens this panel on a phone on the same Wi-Fi network, with a PIN.
painel.destino.rtmp_dica: Facebook, Twitch, Vimeo or a federation's server. Copy the server and the key from the service's page. You set the title and thumbnail there.
painel.destino.youtube_dica: Hallstream creates each live stream on the club's channel, with its title and thumbnail.
painel.ecras.automatico_dica: Switches by itself to Break and Final, and goes back to Scoreboard.
painel.ecras.frase_voltamos_ex: E.g. The picture will return shortly
painel.ecras.jogador_hoje: Player of the day <small class="hint">(shown for 8 s)</small>
painel.ecras.lead: What is on the stream right now.
painel.ecras.miniatura_dica: A 1280x720 image of the chosen game, for the live stream cover.
painel.ecras.previsualizacao_dica: This is what OBS shows over the camera.
painel.ecras.sem_plantel: There is no squad for today yet. Pick the players on the Game tab.
painel.ecras.setup_dica: Seven steps: language, club, scoring, OBS, YouTube and a rehearsal. You do it once, on this computer.
painel.ensaio.demo: In Settings > Demo, turn on demo mode. The graphics show a pretend game, without the box.
painel.ensaio.desconto: Click Timeout. In OBS, the camera shrinks to the graphics window. Then go back to Scoreboard.
painel.ensaio.previa: In Screens, click Opening and then Scoreboard. The preview shows the same as OBS.
painel.ensaio.promo: In Promo, play a video with Sound on and check that you can hear it in OBS.
painel.ensaio.teste: In Screens, click Test stream. The live stream is private. Watch it in YouTube Studio with the channel account, then click End test.
painel.feedback.descricao: What happened, and what you expected
painel.feedback.enviado: Sent. You can follow it here:
painel.feedback.form_texto: You don't need an account. The message is public on GitHub, with the version, the system and the scoring. Don't write anything personal.
painel.feedback.ou_github: Or write on GitHub, with your own account:
painel.feedback.texto: Opens a new issue on GitHub with the version, the system and the scoring filled in. You need a GitHub account, which is free. Write in English or Portuguese.
painel.hist.sem_yt: With YouTube connected in Settings, live streams made outside Hallstream show up here too.
painel.hist.vazio: No streams yet. They show up here after the first live stream with YouTube connected.
painel.imagem.falhou: The image could not be created.
painel.importar.fotos_falharam.outros: {n} photos could not be downloaded from the FPB. Import again later.
painel.importar.fotos_falharam.um: {n} photo could not be downloaded from the FPB. Import again later.
painel.importar.nenhum: No linked player needed a change.
painel.importar.sem_novos: There are no new players on the FPB.
painel.importar.sugestoes: The FPB has these players who are not linked yet. Add them as new players, or link them to a player who already exists.
painel.inicio.lead: You only do it once, on the club's computer. You can stop halfway, as the panel remembers where you left off.
painel.jogo.cor_clara: This colour is too light for white text. Choose a darker one.
painel.jogo.cor_do_emblema: The program picks the colour from the crest.
painel.jogo.fpb_sem_jogos: The FPB has no games for this age group in the next 14 days.
painel.jogo.lead: Choose today's age group and opponent.
painel.jogo.mais_de_12: More than 12 players are selected. Only 12 can play in an official game.
painel.jogo.marque: Select who is playing today. The number only changes for this game.
painel.jogo.mudado: The game was changed on another device
painel.jogo.mudado_dica: You haven't saved what you changed here yet. If you click Save game, it replaces what the other device chose.
painel.jogo.novo_texto: This clears the quarter scores from the previous game. The opponent and the squad stay as they are.
painel.jogo.sem_escaloes: There are no age groups yet. Create one on the Squad tab.
painel.jogo.sem_fpb: This age group is not linked to the FPB. Link it in Squad, or fill in the game by hand.
painel.jogo.sem_jogadores: This age group has no players. Add them in Squad.
painel.marcar.abra: On a phone on the same network, scan the code or open {url}. It asks for the PIN from Settings.
painel.marcar.consola_dica: The Stream Box reads the hall's scoreboard over Bluetooth.
painel.marcar.qr_alt: QR code for the scorer page
painel.marcar.sem_telemovel: To keep score on a phone, first turn on phone access in Settings > Phone and restart the program.
painel.marcar.telemovel_dica: Someone at the table keeps the points, the clock, the fouls and the timeouts on a phone. It also works as a backup if the console fails.
painel.obs.a_configurar: Setting up OBS… It can take a minute if it has to be opened.
painel.obs.falta_resolver: You still need to fix what says Failed.
painel.obs.que_camara: Which camera do you want to use?
painel.offline: No connection to the program. Trying again…
painel.patrocinadores.apagar_texto: The logo will no longer appear on the stream.
painel.patrocinadores.lead: Logos for the white strip and the Supporters screen. The main sponsor first, then the age group's, and last the "General" ones, which appear in every age group.
painel.patrocinadores.ordem: The main sponsor appears larger. The others rotate in list order.
painel.patrocinadores.tipo: The file must be PNG, JPG or SVG.
painel.pin.dica: Enter the 4-digit PIN shown in Settings on the club's computer.
painel.plantel.apagar_escalao_texto: This also deletes the players and sponsors of this age group. It can't be undone.
painel.plantel.apagar_jogador_texto: Removed from this age group's list.
painel.plantel.epoca_nova: The FPB has a new season: choose this age group's team.
painel.plantel.equipas_clube_dica: Creates an age group for each of the club's teams on the FPB, with the players and photos. It can take a minute.
painel.plantel.foto_rodape: Show photo in the name strap
painel.plantel.fotos_dica: Photos come from the FPB when you import or link a player. Players without a photo appear with their initials.
painel.plantel.fotos_dica_sem_fpb: Upload each player's photo under "Photo", or put the photo's address in the CSV. Players without a photo appear with their initials.
painel.plantel.importar_dica: Brings in the players the FPB knows. The names and numbers you entered here don't change.
painel.plantel.ja_nao_estao_dica: They are not in the FPB squad for this season, so they don't appear in games.
painel.plantel.ja_nao_estao_dica_sem_fpb: They are not in the squad for this season, so they don't appear in games.
painel.plantel.lead: Players and coach for each age group.
painel.plantel.ligue_fpb: Link this age group to the FPB team to bring in games and players. You only need to do it once.
painel.plantel.sem_jogadores_fpb: No players. Add them below or import from FPB.
painel.promo.apagar_texto: The video is removed from the list and from the computer. If it is on air, the stream goes back to the previous screen.
painel.promo.escolha: Choose a video from the list to change its text and sound.
painel.promo.lead: Club videos to show during the break or a timeout.
painel.promo.so_vertical: Only vertical videos fit beside the camera.
painel.promo.som_dica: For the sound to reach the stream, turn on "Control audio via OBS" in the properties of the overlay source in OBS.
painel.promo.vazio: No videos yet. Upload an MP4 made on a phone or computer.
painel.stream.falta_jogo: You still need to choose today's game.
painel.stream.falta_marcador: The phone for manual scoring is not connected.
painel.stream.miniatura_falhou: The live stream is on air, but the thumbnail failed. {erro}
painel.stream.no_ar_dica: To end the live stream, click End stream.
painel.stream.pronto_dica: The live stream only starts when you click the button.
painel.stream.pronto_yt: When you click the button, Hallstream creates the live stream on YouTube and starts streaming. To try it without an audience, use Test stream.
painel.stream.sem_obs_dica: Open OBS, or click Set up OBS in Settings.
painel.stream.terminar_texto: The live stream on YouTube ends for everyone watching.
painel.stream.teste_dica: The live stream is private. Only the channel's account can see it, in YouTube Studio. To end it, click End test.
painel.stream.yt_expirou: The YouTube connection has expired. Connect it again in Settings.
painel.transmissoes.lead: The channel's live streams, newest first. Copy the link to send to the players.
painel.wz.caixa_depois: If the console is not nearby, skip ahead. The step is done once the box connects.
painel.wz.caixa_ja: Has already connected to this computer.
painel.wz.caixa_ligue: Turn on the scoreboard console and close the SL Live Stream app on the phones.
painel.wz.camara_por_guardar: Save this camera or press Cancel before moving on.
painel.wz.canal_bloqueado: YouTube says the channel has community guidelines warnings or Content ID blocks. Check YouTube Studio.
painel.wz.canal_confirme: Confirm the two things below on YouTube.
painel.wz.canal_ok: Live streams are turned on and the channel is verified.
painel.wz.canal_por_verificar: YouTube says the channel has not been verified by phone yet.
painel.wz.canal_sem_diretos: YouTube says live streams are not turned on for this channel yet.
painel.wz.canal_texto: Two things on the channel itself, done once with the channel's account.
painel.wz.clube_falta: The club's name and colours are still missing.
painel.wz.clube_fpb_pendente: FPB has not replied yet. Check the internet and click Import club teams, in Squad.
painel.wz.clube_sem_caixa: The scoreboard box has not connected to this computer yet.
painel.wz.clube_texto: The name, short name and colours appear on air. The sport and the country decide where games and squads come from.
painel.wz.concluida_em: Completed on {data}. You can review the steps whenever you like, in Settings > First-time setup.
painel.wz.destino_rtmp: It goes to {servidor}. Set up OBS points OBS there.
painel.wz.diretos_dica: At youtube.com/features, turn on live streams. The first time, YouTube can take up to 24 hours.
painel.wz.diretos_nao: YouTube says they are not turned on yet.
painel.wz.diretos_sim: YouTube confirms live streams are turned on.
painel.wz.ensaio_texto: A short rehearsal before the first game. Tick each one when it is done.
painel.wz.entrada_falta: Where the score comes from isn't chosen yet.
painel.wz.entrada_mao_ok: Scored on a phone, at the table.
painel.wz.entrada_qr: The QR code for the phone is in Scoring.
painel.wz.entrada_texto: You can change it whenever you like, in Scoring.
painel.wz.escaloes_no_plantel.outros: {n} age groups in Squad. Check them and add the coaches.
painel.wz.escaloes_no_plantel.um: {n} age group in Squad. Check it and add the coaches.
painel.wz.escaloes_sozinho: Hallstream creates them by itself the first time it opens, if there is internet.
painel.wz.idioma_texto: The panel, the on-air screens and the log use this language.
painel.wz.obs_por_configurar: OBS has not been set up yet.
painel.wz.obs_texto: Install OBS 31 or newer and DroidCam, and close OBS. Hallstream turns on the WebSocket server, opens OBS and sets up the scene, the graphics, the camera and the resolution.
painel.wz.plantel_csv: Without the FPB, you type squads and games in, or import them from a CSV, in Squad and Game.
painel.wz.sem_yt: With YouTube connected in the previous step, Hallstream asks YouTube. Without it, tick Done it.
painel.wz.so_no_pc: These steps are done on the club's computer. Here you can only see how they are going.
painel.wz.verificado_bloqueado: YouTube won't let this channel be verified, because it has warnings or blocks.
painel.wz.verificado_dica: At youtube.com/verify, confirm the channel with a code by SMS. Without it, the live stream still starts, but without the game thumbnail.
painel.wz.verificado_nao: YouTube says it is not verified yet.
painel.wz.verificado_sim: YouTube confirms the channel is verified.
painel.wz.yt_conta: It must be the account that owns the channel, or the owner or manager of the channel's brand account. An invitation under Permissions in YouTube Studio is not enough, because Google doesn't let those accounts use the API.
painel.wz.yt_depois: This can wait. The stream works without YouTube linked to Hallstream, as it has until now.
painel.wz.yt_expirou: The YouTube connection has expired. Click Connect to YouTube again.
painel.wz.yt_falta: Hallstream still needs to be connected to the club's channel.
painel.wz.yt_passo2: Click Connect to YouTube. Sign in with the Google account that manages the club's channel and, if Google asks, choose the club's channel.
painel.wz.yt_passo3: Google warns that the app has not been verified. Click Advanced and then Go to Hallstream. The app is the club's own.
painel.wz.yt_precisa: You need the OAuth client ID and secret, created in Google Cloud with the CONNECT-YOUTUBE.txt guide, in the YouTube folder.
painel.wz.yt_sem_id: Without the ID and secret, click Skip for now. The stream still works, with the YouTube account connected in OBS itself.
painel.yt.a_espera: Waiting for sign-in on the Google page. Sign in with the account that manages the club's channel, choose the club's channel and click Continue.
painel.yt.a_terminar_dica: YouTube closes the live stream about a minute later. Then Hallstream makes the video unlisted and the link appears here.
painel.yt.ainda_nao: YouTube is not connected yet. You connect it once, on the club's computer, in First-time setup.
painel.yt.cole: Paste the OAuth client ID and secret, created in Google Cloud with the CONNECT-YOUTUBE.txt guide, in the YouTube folder next to the program.
painel.yt.desligar_texto: Hallstream stops creating the live streams and making the videos unlisted. The videos stay on the channel as they are.
painel.yt.desligar_texto2: OBS keeps sending to Hallstream's key. To use the account connected in OBS again, connect it in Settings > OBS stream.
painel.yt.expirou: The YouTube connection has expired. Click Connect to YouTube to sign in again.
painel.yt.ligado_dica: When you click Start stream, Hallstream creates this game's public live stream, with the title and thumbnail. When it ends, the video becomes unlisted and the link appears in Screens.
painel.yt.nao_listado:
Unlisted video

Only people with the link can see the game. Link: {link}
painel.yt.segredo_guardado: Saved. Leave blank to keep it
painel.yt.so_no_pc: It can only be connected or disconnected on the club's computer.
painel.yt.teste_terminado:
Test ended

The video stayed private: only the channel's account can see it, in YouTube Studio > Content > Live. You can delete it there. Link: {link}
proximo.equipa_desconhecida: FPB doesn't know the team for this age group.
proximo.fpb_ocupada: FPB is getting too many requests.
proximo.sem_escalao: Choose the game's age group first.
proximo.sem_jogo: I couldn't find another scheduled game for this age group.
proximo.sem_jogos: This age group has no scheduled games. Connect it to FPB or add them in Game > Calendar.
yt.ainda_nao_acabou: YouTube hasn't marked the live stream as ended yet. Click Try again in a few minutes.
yt.cliente_recusado: Google did not accept the OAuth client ID or secret. Check them in Settings > YouTube
yt.desligado_antes: YouTube was disconnected before the video became unlisted. Connect it in Settings and click Try again.
yt.expirou: The YouTube connection has expired. In Settings > YouTube, click Connect to YouTube again.
yt.login_demorou: the YouTube sign-in took too long. Click Connect to YouTube again.
yt.login_falhou: I couldn't finish the sign-in. Go back to the panel to see what happened.
yt.login_ok: Connected to YouTube. You can close this window and go back to the panel.
yt.login_outro_pedido: This request didn't come from Hallstream. Go back to the panel and click Connect to YouTube.
yt.login_outro_utilizador: the YouTube sign-in was saved by another Windows user; connect again: {err}
yt.login_tente_outra_vez: {motivo} Go back to the panel to try again.
yt.miniatura_recusada: YouTube didn't accept the thumbnail, because the channel is not verified yet at youtube.com/verify. The live stream carries on with whatever image YouTube picks.
yt.nao_listado_falhou: I couldn't make the video unlisted: {err}
yt.nao_protegi_login: I couldn't protect the YouTube sign-in: {err}
yt.nao_sei_se_acabou: I couldn't find out from YouTube whether the live stream ended ({err}). Click Try again.
yt.nunca_no_ar: The live stream never went on air on YouTube, so there is no video.
yt.obs_nao_envia: I couldn't get OBS to send to YouTube: {err}
yt.sem_acesso_duradouro: Google did not give lasting access. Remove Hallstream's access at myaccount.google.com/permissions and connect again
yt.sem_canal: this Google account has no YouTube channel
yt.teste_precisa: The test stream needs YouTube connected in Settings > YouTube.
